issues: Near-pure black with thin grey lines — dim and unlit; almost nothing is legible before the fill

changes: Look switched to ember; rewritten in native 1920 coordinates: 220px / 500 Helvetica Neue outline (2px warm-grey stroke), r=410 dashed circle + an inner 72-tick bezel + four registration ticks

Fast/slow contrast kept: 11f word shrink (snappy + velocity-based defocus) vs 44f circle settle (EASE.out); the stroke warms to bright orange-white over 44–53f
Duration 75→90f with a 36f hold after the fill, push-in 1→1.015; the fill is a frame-based hard cut instead of a normalised time window
